Description

*This venue has a no cancellation policy*

Looking to hire a 5-a-side football pitch in central London? Waterloo Wolf Turf has the perfect facilities for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 5-a-side football at Waterloo Wolf Turf is played on astroturf. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 5-a-side football machine, Waterloo Wolf Turf is the right choice for you.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

The closest station when travelling is Streatham. The facility is located a short walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.
